## Creating the variable

```{r}
#| label: maxbrshare-starter

# STARTER: provided by Erwyna so the pipeline runs. Riely owns and must explain this.
# TODO(Riely): add a comment on each line saying what it does, in your own words.
soap <- soap_raw |>
  rowwise() |>                                            # work one household (row) at a time
  mutate(MaxBrShare = max(c_across(all_of(brand_cols)))) |> # largest of the eight named brand shares
  ungroup()                                               # leave row-wise mode
```
